subject: maths
question: Neha is manufacturing plastic lunch boxes for a job. She got a project to manufacture some boxes, out of which she completed frac{{15}}{{23}} of the project in 30 days. In how many days did she complete the entire project for the company?
solution:
**Given**

frac{{15}}{{23}} boxes completed in 30 days

let the total project to be 1

multiplying by ​(23)/(15)on both sides we get

​(15)/(23)times (23)/(15) boxes will be completed in 30 times (23)/(15)​

1 box will be completed in 23times2=46 days

**The total work will be completed in 46 days**

​
